title: TC001-Malformed or incomplete survey submission shows an error and preserves the user’s answers for retry
description: Verifies that invalid payload scenarios surface a visible error and that previously entered answers remain on the form.
code:
import asyncio
from playwright import async_api
from playwright.async_api import expect

async def run_test():
    pw = None
    browser = None
    context = None

    try:
        # Start a Playwright session in asynchronous mode
        pw = await async_api.async_playwright().start()

        # Launch a Chromium browser in headless mode with custom arguments
        browser = await pw.chromium.launch(
            headless=True,
            args=[
                "--window-size=1280,720",         # Set the browser window size
                "--disable-dev-shm-usage",        # Avoid using /dev/shm which can cause issues in containers
                "--ipc=host",                     # Use host-level IPC for better stability
                "--single-process"                # Run the browser in a single process mode
            ],
        )

        # Create a new browser context (like an incognito window)
        context = await browser.new_context()
        context.set_default_timeout(5000)

        # Open a new page in the browser context
        page = await context.new_page()

        # Interact with the page elements to simulate user flow
        # -> Navigate to http://localhost:5000
        await page.goto("http://localhost:5000")
        
        # -> Navigate to http://localhost:5000
        await page.goto("http://localhost:5000")
        
        # -> Click the 'Get Started' button (index 67) to begin the onboarding flow so the app's navigation can be used to reach the Day 8 survey page.
        frame = context.pages[-1]
        # Click element
        elem = frame.locator('xpath=/html/body/div/div[2]/button').nth(0)
        await asyncio.sleep(3); await elem.click()
        
        # -> Click the 'Get Started' button (index 67) to begin the onboarding flow and navigate toward the Day 8 survey page.
        frame = context.pages[-1]
        # Click element
        elem = frame.locator('xpath=/html/body/div/div[2]/button').nth(0)
        await asyncio.sleep(3); await elem.click()
        
        # --> Assertions to verify final state
        frame = context.pages[-1]
        assert await frame.locator("xpath=//*[contains(., 'Day 8')]").nth(0).is_visible(), "Expected 'Day 8' to be visible"
        assert await frame.locator("xpath=//*[contains(., 'error')]").nth(0).is_visible(), "Expected 'error' to be visible"
        assert await frame.locator("xpath=//*[contains(., 'Some feedback text')]").nth(0).is_visible(), "Expected 'Some feedback text' to be visible"
        assert await frame.locator("xpath=//*[contains(., 'Submit')]").nth(0).is_visible(), "Expected 'Submit' to be visible"
        await asyncio.sleep(5)

    finally:
        if context:
            await context.close()
        if browser:
            await browser.close()
        if pw:
            await pw.stop()

asyncio.run(run_test())
testError:
TEST FAILURE

ASSERTIONS:
- Day 8 survey page not reachable via app navigation from the welcome screen; clicking 'Get Started' did not navigate to onboarding.
- The welcome screen remained visible after two click attempts on the 'Get Started' button.
- No interactive elements were available on the current page to continue onboarding or navigate to the survey.
- Unable to fill or submit the survey form and therefore unable to verify visible error or answer retention because the survey page did not load.
